sql.description: One PostgreSQL read statement (SELECT, VALUES, TABLE, SHOW, or EXPLAIN of a read query). Physical tables and views require schema-qualified names. System schemas and application routines are permitted; writes and transaction control are rejected.

parameters.description: At most 65,535 ordered JSON values bound separately to $1, $2, etc. PostgreSQL infers types; use SQL casts when needed. Null means SQL NULL. Objects/arrays become JSON text; PostgreSQL array inputs use array-text strings with casts.

row_limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to this connection's limits.max_rows from list_connections and must not exceed it.
